avoid_supplements.name: Opioid-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and respiratory depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory compromise, and overdose risk

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Valerian root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depressant effects potentiating sedation and cognitive impairment
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for excessive drowsiness and impaired coordination

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive neurological effects; may enhance dizziness or ataxia
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient tolerance; space dosing if feasible and counsel on dizziness precautions

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild additive CNS effects; theoretical interaction with serotonergic pathways
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient of potential additive effects; monitor for excessive sedation

caution_supplements.name: Kava kava
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and potential hepatotoxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation and cognitive effects; counsel on alcohol avoidance

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Significant additive CNS depression, impaired cognition, increased dizziness, ataxia, and respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Strongly advise against concurrent alcohol consumption; counsel on impaired judgment and fall risk

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay pregabalin absorption and peak concentration
caution_foods.action: Administer pregabalin consistently with or without food to maintain stable levels

monitoring_notes: Pregabalin undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism and is renally eliminated, limiting CYP-mediated interactions but requiring renal function monitoring. Monitor for additive CNS depression, dizziness, ataxia, cognitive impairment, and weight gain; assess fall risk especially in elderly patients, and counsel patients on alcohol avoidance and safe driving practices.
